headline: WEST AFRICAN RESOURCES BANKS $4,556/OZ IN Q2 — 232,905 OZ YTD ON TRACK FOR RECORD 430-490K OZ YEAR (ASX:WAF)
source_name: Motley Fool Australia / West African Resources Ltd (ASX:WAF)
snippet: West African Resources (ASX:WAF) posted June quarter results on July 7 showing 232,905 ounces of gold produced year-to-date from its Sanbrado and Kiaka operations in Burkina Faso — a pace squarely on track for its record 2026 guidance of 430,000–490,000 ounces at below US$1,900/oz AISC — with Q2 gold averaging $4,556 per ounce realized, roughly $400 above current spot. Underground mined ounces at Sanbrado rose 60% quarter-on-quarter despite temporary explosives-permit delays at Kiaka cutting open-pit output, demonstrating operational resilience from the company's first full year running two mines simultaneously.

headline: ARIS MINING H1 UP 31% TO 148KOZ AT $4,445/OZ — $680M+ REVENUE AS MARMATO CIP TARGETS Q4 FIRST GOLD (TSX:ARIS)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Aris Mining Corp. (TSX:ARIS)
snippet: Aris Mining Corp. (TSX:ARIS) reported July 7 that H1 2026 consolidated gold production reached 148,000 ounces — a 31% year-over-year increase — with Q2 alone contributing 73,700 oz at an average realized price of approximately $4,445 per ounce, generating H1 gold revenue exceeding $680 million and keeping the company on track for its 2026 production guidance. The Marmato CIP plant upgrade, targeting first gold in Q4 2026, is the next catalyst expected to materially reduce processing costs and re-rate Aris from mid-tier producer to a low-cost Tier-1 Americas gold platform.

headline: CENTERRA + TECK-BACKED METAL ENERGY FIRES FIRST DRILL AT UNTESTED NIV PORPHYRY — 6,000M IN BC'S TOODOGGONE (TSXV:MERG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Metal Energy Corp. (TSXV:MERG)
snippet: Metal Energy Corp. (TSXV:MERG) announced July 6 that its inaugural drill is turning at the NIV copper-gold porphyry project in BC's Toodoggone District — 12,500 hectares that have never been drill-tested — with 6,000+ metres planned across 12 holes along the full NIV system length, 32 km south of Centerra Gold's Kemess mine complex. Centerra Gold and Teck Resources each hold 9.9% stakes in Metal Energy, a dual strategic-shareholder structure that signals institutional confidence in an untested porphyry target in one of BC's most productive exploration belts at $6.19/lb copper.

headline: ERRINGTON METALS ADDS 2,727 HA — SUDBURY BASIN LAND POSITION GROWS 48% AROUND ERRINGTON NICKEL-COPPER ZONE (TSXV:EM)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Errington Metals Corp. (TSXV:EM)
snippet: Errington Metals Corp. (TSXV:EM) signed a purchase and sale agreement July 7 to acquire 2,727 hectares of unpatented mining claims in the Sudbury Basin, expanding its land position by approximately 48% and consolidating contiguous ground around the Errington Zone in the world's premier nickel-copper-PGE camp — which hosts approximately 10% of the world's identified nickel resources across more than 40 active mines. Land consolidation by a focused junior following strong 2025 drill results is the standard precursor to a systematic resource expansion program in the Sudbury setting.

headline: PHENOM GETS USFS PERMIT FOR NEVADA'S DOBBIN — FIRST DRILL ON CARLIN GOLD ANOMALY PEAKING AT 2.73 G/T AU (TSXV:PHNM)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Phenom Resources Corp. (TSXV:PHNM)
snippet: Phenom Resources Corp. (TSXV:PHNM) received its US Forest Service Plan of Operations permit for the Dobbin gold project in Nevada on July 6, clearing the final regulatory hurdle for the first drill test in the project's history at a Carlin-style gold system where soil sampling has returned values from 0.1 to 2.73 g/t Au along a northeast-trending structural corridor. Phenom has secured drill and road contractors and the summer 2026 program now has a clear window — a first-ever drill event at a never-tested Carlin-type system in Nevada's proven gold belt is the kind of binary catalyst retail junior mining investors track closely.

headline: SILVER DEFENDS $62 IN 6TH CONSECUTIVE DEFICIT YEAR — 800M OZ CUMULATIVE SHORTFALL BUILDS STRUCTURAL FLOOR BENEATH SPOT
snippet: Silver held near $62.10–$62.52 per ounce on July 7, with $64 as the primary technical breakout level where a sustained close above opens the path toward $72, while a failure to hold $62 risks a retest of $55. The Silver Institute projects a 67-million-ounce structural supply deficit in 2026 — the sixth consecutive year of shortfall — pushing the five-year cumulative deficit past 800 million ounces, the equivalent of an entire year of global mine production, providing a structural demand floor that persists regardless of the near-term FOMC catalyst scheduled for July 8.

headline: GOLD'S LATE-JULY REBOUND WINDOW OPENS — $4,400-$4,460 FIRST TARGET AS MINERS DIVERGE FROM METAL PRICE ACTION
snippet: A Discovery Alert technical analysis published this week identifies late July through August as the primary window for gold's next recovery leg from the June $3,993 corrective low, with $4,400–$4,460 as first resistance (~$300 above current spot) and silver targeting $67–$70 — while flagging the sharp divergence between gold mining stocks and the metal's own Q2 rebound as the primary technical signal that speculative leverage is being reset rather than destroyed. The analysis is consistent with Goldman Sachs, WGC, and State Street all reaffirming their bullish thesis after the Q2 selloff, and the miner-divergence indicator historically closes in the quarter following a major gold correction.

headline: ENERGY FUELS TARGETS Q4 COMMERCIAL HEAVY RARE EARTHS — FIRST US DYSPROSIUM AND TERBIUM OXIDE AT WHITE MESA (NYSE:UUUU)
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE:UUUU) has advanced its timeline for heavy rare earth commercial production at its White Mesa Mill in Utah to Q4 2026, targeting commercial-scale separated dysprosium and terbium oxide — the critical inputs for permanent magnets used in EV motors and wind turbines — following the successful qualification of US-produced NdPr for permanent magnet use in June 2026. As the only US facility processing both uranium and rare earth elements in an integrated operation, White Mesa's heavy REE ramp positions Energy Fuels as the sole domestic source of separated heavy rare earths at a moment when China's export controls on REE processing technology have heightened the strategic urgency of non-Chinese supply chains.

headline: GOLDSEEK ISSUE #72: GOLD AND SILVER STOCKS COILING FOR A CATALYST — ISM SERVICES, FOMC MINUTES AND NON-COMMERCIAL POSITIONING RESET
snippet: GoldSeek's Issue #72 weekly mining roundup frames the current gold, silver and mining stock setup as a pre-catalyst coil, with the June FOMC minutes (July 8) and ISM Services PMI as the two scheduled events that will determine whether the post-payrolls recovery extends to key resistance or stalls — and notes that non-commercial speculators have not yet rebuilt positioning to levels consistent with new highs, leaving room for a significant momentum move if the minutes confirm the 9-9 rate-split without a strong hawkish lean. For junior mining investors, the weekly analysis specifically highlights that GDX and SIL have lagged the metals' own post-payrolls bounce, making them leveraged to both outcomes: a dovish-reading rally would be amplified in miners, while a hawkish surprise would punish them disproportionately.

headline: COPPER HOLDS $6.19 AS CHINESE FUNDS ROTATE INTO METAL STOCKS AHEAD OF H1 EARNINGS — $6.15 FLOOR IN FOCUS
snippet: LME copper held above $6.15 per pound on July 7, 2026, with futures trading in a narrow range for a second straight week as Chinese investment funds rotated into copper mining stocks and futures ahead of expected strong first-half earnings from major producers — a demand impulse that coincided with traders scaling back September Fed rate-hike bets from 66% to ~50% following the June payrolls miss. INN's Q2 2026 copper review notes the metal has remained above its January opening price while gold fell ~24% from its January all-time high, reflecting the tight physical supply backdrop that tariff-driven supply chain fragmentation is turning into a structural premium for copper discoveries outside existing supply chains.
